description: The Smarter Every Day channel features host Destin Sandlin, an aerospace engineer, exploring a wide range of scientific topics through hands-on investigation and slow-motion filming. The videos often take the form of deep dives into specific subjects like helicopter physics, bird flight, or the mechanics of a nuclear submarine, where he seeks out experts to explain complex concepts. Episodes frequently focus on understanding how things work in the physical world, from the Prince Rupert's drop to the inner workings of the U.S. Coast Guard.
